title: Treatise of the Twin-Court Axe
summary: Teaches the court of two edges, bit and beard, as one weapon, from first grip to the final great cleave.

title: Hawk-Strike Canon of the Azure Axe
summary: Describes the diving blows and lifting guards that the hawk-schools of Azure Sky teach to Xiantian axe-bearers.

title: Compendium of the Basin Cleave
summary: Collects the wide cleaving strokes of the basin schools, in which the axe sweeps as a river sweeps its basin.

title: Paired Cleave Canon of the Dual Tracks
summary: Rare canon for a Monarch of rare skill, setting body track and qi track to one great cleaving stroke.

title: Canon of the Azure Descent
summary: Collects the long falling cuts of the high schools, in which the axe descends from a great height with Xiantian qi.

title: Twin-Bit Court Drill-Book
summary: Drills the user to strike with first one edge and then the other until the opponent cannot track either.

title: Treatise of the Basin-Wide Sweep
summary: Teaches the widest sweeping cuts of the basin schools, which clear a whole front in one stroke.

title: River-Court Axe Compendium
summary: Gathers the court cuts of the river schools, in which the axe is carried like a river carries silt.

title: Oath-Sworn Canon of the Plateau Axe
summary: Sets the sworn bearing of a wind-sworn student to a long line of axe cuts that hold their line.

title: Treatise on the Gale Edge
summary: Gives the wind-sworn student cuts in which the edge itself carries qi like a gust.

title: Bearing and Oath: A Plateau Axe Canon
summary: Rare canon for a Monarch of the wind schools, joining a held bearing to an oath-sworn great cleave.

title: Canon of the Unwalled Axe
summary: Teaches an axe style for open ground, in which no wall or gate is ever counted upon.

title: Windward Cleave Compendium
summary: Gathers the cleaving strokes of the wind schools, which are thrown into the wind with a steady bearing.

title: Oath of the Hewing Wind
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn student to hew with the wind at the back and an oath at the heart.

title: Bearing-Keeper's Axe Treatise
summary: Teaches the student who keeps a bearing against all pressure to carry an axe through a long fight.

title: Canon of the Open-Plateau Cleave
summary: Teaches a Xiantian student the great cleaves suited to open plateau ground, where nothing stops the swing.
